english_draft: Oracle is expected to report its FY2027 Q2 results on or near 2026-12-09. The target quarter ends 2026-11-30. The prior quarter is FY2027 Q1, ended 2026-08-31. Source: Oracle Q1 results announcement dated 2026-09-10. Baseline: total revenue was USD 19.345 billion, up 30% year over year. Cloud revenue was USD 11.607 billion, up 62%. Cloud infrastructure IaaS revenue was about USD 7.4 billion, up 121%. Cloud applications SaaS revenue was about USD 4.2 billion, up 10%. GAAP operating income was about USD 6.7 billion. Non-GAAP operating income was about USD 8.2 billion. Remaining performance obligations were USD 664 billion. Free cash flow was negative USD 5 billion. Three core questions for the target quarter: first, can IaaS revenue sustain triple-digit growth? Second, does the huge RPO convert into recognized revenue? Third, does negative free cash flow improve or worsen? Positive surprise: IaaS growth remains at or above 100%, cloud revenue remains near 60% year-over-year growth, RPO expands, and non-GAAP operating margin stays stable. Negative surprise: IaaS growth falls below 100%, cloud revenue decelerates, non-GAAP margin compresses, or free cash flow worsens. Verification items: total revenue, cloud revenue split, RPO, GAAP and non-GAAP operating income, and free cash flow.
reader_questions: 目标季度是自然年2026Q4，而上季是自然年2026Q3（甲骨文FY2027 Q1）；财报日期2026-12-09是否已经由公司确认，还是仅为推算？
Q1自由现金流为负50亿美元，这是否主要来自AI数据中心资本开支？若只看经营现金流，是否仍为正值？
RPO 6640亿美元中有多少会在未来12个月内确认为收入？如果大部分是长期订单，本季营收增速能否只依赖存量合同？
fact_checks: 来源标题显示Oracle Q1 results driven by triple-digit growth in cloud infrastructure revenues，发布日2026-09-10，季度截至2026-08-31。
总营收193.45亿美元、同比+30%；云收入116.07亿美元、同比+62%；IaaS约74亿美元、同比+121%；SaaS约42亿美元、同比+10%，均来自所附来源事实。
GAAP营业利润约67亿美元与非GAAP营业利润约82亿美元口径不同，正文已分开标注。
RPO 6640亿美元和自由现金流-50亿美元来自Q1公告；目标季度数据尚未公开，本稿没有编造。
目标财报日2026-12-09为估计值，材料中未发现公司IR对日期的确认。
